name: Metsjö - Kaserna
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage from Metsjö to Kaserna, mainly on dirt roads and forest paths through Herrestadsfjället, Viksjön, Modalen and Strömmarna; includes a hand-pulled raft crossing over Munkedalsälven because the bridge in Strömmarna must not be used; no public ferry or official alternate geometry found

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: 15. Metsjö - Kaserna
keyFacts: Official WST title is 15. Metsjö - Kaserna; English page title appears as Metsjö - Kaserna.
Official direction is Metsjö to Kaserna.
Official distance is 17 km.
Official estimated time is 6-7 h.
Official difficulty is red / hard.
Surface is dirt roads and forest paths.
Route runs between Metsjö in Uddevalla municipality and Kaserna in Munkedal municipality.
Route passes dense spruce woodland, steep cliff edges, lakes, old cultural landscape and hilly/challenging sections.
WST calls out Strömmarna nature reserve and the view over Lake Trästickeln as not-to-miss features.
WST says neither Metsjö nor Kaserna is easy by public transport.
WST states the Munkedalsälven crossing uses a transport raft and hikers must not tie the raft.
caveats: WST route prose includes old 2019 bridge-demolition wording; current WST status and authority pages are fresher for the bridge/raft issue.
Live-check WST before publication because the Kaserna bridge reconstruction and Strömmarna raft status are currentness-sensitive.

dogs: Dogs must be leashed in Herrestadsfjället.
Strömmarna page did not list a separate leash rule in the lane, but general Swedish law and reserve etiquette apply.
From 1 March to 20 August dogs must be under extra strict supervision; Naturvårdsverket's interpretation is that this usually means leash.
The dog-control period was active on the accessed date, 2026-04-29.
huntingFishingForestryAndLivestock: No route closure for hunting, forestry or livestock was found in current official checks.
Avoid disturbing signed/active hunting and choose another place if hunting is underway.
Fishing is not part of allemansrätten; check permits and local rules before fishing in Stage 15 lakes/watercourses.
Reserve rules restrict some land-management activities internally, but these are mostly manager/landowner rules rather than hiker-facing route closures.
seasonalHazards: Raft operation can be affected by low water, ice movement and maintenance.
Strömmarna has steep terrain and technical/slippery elements; field report mentions fixed ropes after the river crossing.
AllTrails/field reports include muddy, overgrown and obstruction signals on the Kaserna/Viksjön part in April 2025.
Rural access roads and transit are exact-date/weather/season sensitive.

Hikers used the raft successfully, but noted it may stop during ice movement or low water and another party briefly grounded in low water. Report observed Modalen toilet, shelter, meadow and nearby stream water, Viksjön toilet issues, and fixed ropes after the river crossing.
